pokedexEntries.rb: Eats bugs in grassy areas. It has to flap its short wings at high speed to stay airborne.

pokedexEntries.ye: Inept at flying high. However, it can fly around very fast to protect its territory.

pokedexEntries.go: It flaps its short wings to flush out insects from tall grass. It then plucks them with its stubby beak.

pokedexEntries.si: Very protective of its territory, it flaps its short wings busily to dart around at high speed.

pokedexEntries.cr: To protect its territory, it flies around ceaselessly, making high-pitched cries.

pokedexEntries.rs: SPEAROW has a very loud cry that can be heard over half a mile away. If its high, keening cry is heard echoing all around, it is a sign that they are warning each other of danger.

pokedexEntries.fr: It busily flits around here and there. Even if it is frail, it can be a tough foe that uses MIRROR MOVE.

pokedexEntries.lg: Eats bugs in grassy areas. It has to flap its short wings at high speed to stay airborne.

pokedexEntries.em: Its loud cry can be heard over half a mile away. If its high, keening cry is heard echoing all around, it is a sign that they are warning each other of danger.

pokedexEntries.dpp: It flaps its small wings busily to fly. Using its beak, it searches in grass for prey.

pokedexEntries.su: Its short wings make it inept at flying. It moves about hurriedly and pecks at Bug-type Pokémon in the tall grass.

pokedexEntries.mo: Farmers whose fields are troubled by bug Pokémon appreciate Spearow for its vigorous appetite and look after it.

pokedexEntries.us: Its reckless nature leads it to stand up to others—even large Pokémon—if it has to protect its territory.

pokedexEntries.um: Due to its short wings, it can’t fly long distances. It wanders about restlessly and pecks at bug Pokémon.
